description.narrative: Country portfolio budget - CPB Gambia 2019-2024 Provide school meals to pre-and primary school children vulnerable to food insecurity during the school year and strengthen capacity of local government to manage school meal programmes as a national safety net.

sector.narrative: By 2030, end hunger and ensure access by all people, in particular the poor and people in vulnerable situations, including infants, to safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round
